mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (id, username, password, nickname, email, enabled, tenant_id, daily_token_limit, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{enabled}, #{tenantId}, #{dailyTokenLimit}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, enabled = #{enabled}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, daily_token_limit = #{dailyTokenLimit}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id})

sql.if: WHERE LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}), LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', username, nickname, email, tenant_id))) > 0

mapper.select: SELECT u.*, ur.role_code AS list_role_code, r.enabled AS list_role_enabled FROM (SELECT * FROM sys_user ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageable.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageable.offset}) u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = ur.role_code ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC, ur.role_code
